goal: Put two slices of bread from the bread shelf into the two toaster slots, press the toaster lever down, and return both arms to their start pose.
instruction_templates: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
success: For slot S in {toast_slot1, toast_slot2} (both required, simultaneously): at least ONE of the four breads bread_0..bread_3 satisfies both: (a) bread origin xy lies inside the quadrilateral formed by the toaster's 4 passive functional points tagged S (is_pointA_in_B_functional_bbox; point-in-polygon, tolerance 1e-6 m, no z test there), and (b) bread origin z minus the z of one of the toaster's passive functional points tagged S lies strictly between 0.03 and 0.065 m (is_A_point_above_B_point_by_z_range, z_lower=0.03, z_upper=0.065).

Every one of the four breads bread_0..bread_3 must have at least one of its local axes +x, -x, +y, -y within 30 deg of world up (i.e. no bread lying flat with local z up; breads are not allowed to fall over).

Exactly 2 of the 4 breads have their origin inside the bread_shelf (is_N_A_in_B, N=2; is_A_in_B on the shelf bbox: origin xy in the shelf bbox hull and origin z > shelf bbox z_min) -- the count must be exactly 2, not at least 2.

Toaster lever: for the toaster's joint(s) tagged 'toast_botton' (sic), (position - lower)/(upper - lower) > 0.85 for at least one such joint (is_joint_position_above_ratio, percentage=0.85) at the moment of checking.

all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, at the same action boundary as all other conditions. Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
evaluation: All listed conditions are checked together, in order, after every action (reward_manager.step runs once per action, after the action's whole control sequence has executed; nothing is checked between actions). They form a single stage: all must be true at the same action boundary (any list inside the conditions means 'at least one of'). Success is declared at the first action boundary where all hold; the episode then ends. No final_check list is used. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim actions. No early-fail rule. The lever condition is a current-state test, so the lever must be at >85% of its range at the same action boundary at which the breads are in the slots and the arms are back (unless the asset's lever latches down, which cannot be determined statically).
objects: toaster: articulated two-slot toaster (category toaster, idx 0 or 1), 1, x in [0.04,0.35], y in [-0.12,-0.03] (table frame), z 0.08, yaw -105..-75 deg; functional tags toast_slot1, toast_slot2, toast_botton (lever joint)
bread_shelf: static bread rack (category bread_shelf), 1, x in [-0.35,0.0], y in [-0.2,0.0], yaw up to +-15 deg
bread_0..bread_3: four bread slices (category bread idx 0), each placed in shelf slot 0..3 respectively ('up' tag) on bread_shelf
scene_dynamics: none (the toaster lever is an articulated joint that moves only when pushed; its return/latching behaviour is defined by the asset and cannot be read statically).
end_requirements: all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, (part of the success condition). Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
physics_kind: mixed: rigid bread/clutter + articulated toaster (lever joint)
notes: Which two breads go in which slot is free; the test only needs one bread per slot plus exactly two left in the shelf. Since the 'z above slot point' band is 0.03..0.065 m relative to the toaster's slot functional points (any of the 4 points), bread must be seated in the slot, not hovering. make_toast_random is the clutter/other-toaster variant with a wider z band; here the band is the narrow (0.03, 0.065). The bread-up condition is an OR over four local axes for each bread; which local axis is the bread's face normal is asset-defined. 'toast_botton' is the literal tag spelling in the code. Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
